description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'PolicyIdNotAccessibleException' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingException, representing an error condition when a Policy ID on a Thing is inaccessible due to absence or insufficient permissions. The file includes builder patterns, JSON parsing capabilities, and static methods for constructing instances from messages or JSON objects.

classes.name: PolicyIdNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that the Policy ID of a specific Thing is either missing or inaccessible due to permissions. It includes builders for creating instances, static factory methods for JSON deserialization and message-based creation, and integrates with the Ditto framework's exception handling mechanisms.
